metadata.frequencyMeaning: Each action frequency is a fraction from 0 to 1; convert to percent only for display.
metadata.scope: Heads-up restricted action-tree benchmark; near-equilibrium only for this tree and its supplied ranges.

upstream.artifactNote: Generated strategy results only; no upstream engine code or binary is included. This metadata is provenance, not a legal determination.

BB_call.description: Saved ReysonAI preflop BB call-frequency estimate after BTN 2.5BB open and SB fold; used as the BB input range.

inputs.note: These input ranges are ReysonAI estimates, not solver-derived preflop GTO ranges.
